verdict.rationale: ELSTER documents its own programmatic channel: any tax software that supports ELSTER can transmit filings, such as the Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung, over the same certificate-authenticated rail as the portal. Nothing shows that the rest of the UI is reachable that way, including uploading Belege, the mailbox and Postfachvertreter, submitting Vollmachten, retrieving Bescheide or applying for a Steuernummer. A probe found the ERiC developer-artifact host timing out for a keyless client, which casts doubt on open developer access but does not contradict the filing channel. missing for 10: documented public API reference, evidence of API coverage for portal features beyond tax-return transmission (Belege, Postfach, Bescheide retrieval, Vollmachten, registration forms), reliably reachable developer artifacts, independent hands-on corroboration of API/UI parity
